commonCriteria.correctnessOracle: Native checksum must exactly match the row-reference checksum for every benchmarked shape and row count.
commonCriteria.admissionRule: A native path may be enabled by default only when every listed shape passes the correctness oracle and meets the slowdown/allocation thresholds at both row counts on the target tier.

candidates.semanticEnvelope: Typed numeric filter plus projection over replayable columnar input.
Single typed group key with COUNT/SUM-style numeric aggregate state.
Typed sortable key over replayable columnar input with stable row ordinal tie-break.
Inner equi-join on a typed non-null-compatible key with SQL null semantics.

resultStatus.notes: The 2026-07-10 benchmark capture shows the current native columnar candidates are slower than the row-reference paths at both checked row counts. No new native path is approved by this capture.
